Every number here comes from a result file committed in the repository (`engine/ts/packages/bench/results`). Re-run them with `npm run bench` and `node packages/bench/src/e2e.ts` in `engine/ts`.

## Whole programs: original vs Viscosity (JavaScript)

Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, Node v22.23.4 (V8 12.4.254.21-node.57), 2026-10-31. Median of N fresh-process runs of each program’s own timed section. Shared cloud VM.

| program | layout chosen | original (ms) | Viscosity (ms) | speed-up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| boids | `fl=soa` | 84 | 71 | **1.18×** |
| heat | `cells=soa` | 364 | 110 | **3.3×** |
| ledger | `tx=soa` | 237 | 46 | **5.11×** |
| nbody | `bs=soa` | 67 | 61 | **1.09×** |
| particles | `ps=soa` | 405 | 94 | **4.3×** |

The checksums of the original and compiled programs matched exactly in every run.
